thread:
Irene Morales: Quick announcement: we activated a small MI250X warm/burst pool in Nairobi (NBO) for Dedicated tenants effective now. Intended to reduce regional tail latency for customers in EMEA/APAC.

Devon K: Size and per-tenant limits?

Irene Morales: Pool = 40 MI250X GPUs. Per-tenant burst cap = 8 GPUs. Single reservation max = 6 hours. 2h cooldown between burst reservations per tenant.

Samir Patel: Private/VPC impact?

Irene Morales: No impact to Private/VPC. This is hosted Dedicated only.

Maya Chen: Rollout plan?

Irene Morales: Canary with 3 enterprise customers for 48h starting now. Self-serve reservations open next Tue if canary is green.

Devon K: Ops runbook / alerts?

Irene Morales: Runbook posted. Watch scheduler.backlog, gpu.provision.failures, and unexpected_preemptions. If free capacity <10% for >15m notify infra-backfill.

OpsBot: RUNBOOK: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mi250x-nbo-burst

Irene Morales: CLI sample for CS:
```
redwoodctl capacity reserve --pool mi250x-nbo-burst --count 4 --duration 3h --team acme-corp
```
Irene Morales: Pricing note: burst multiplier = 1.25x on-demand Dedicated rate (temporary). Billing line item = "burst-dedicated-mi250x".

Samir Patel: Performance guidance?

Irene Morales: Recommend small batch sizing for first 5k tokens while KV warms. Optimized MI250X kernel build ships tomorrow.

Maya Chen: Docs/comms?

Irene Morales: CS owns customer outreach; eng-docs + product own docs. Draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/mi250x-nbo-burst. Review by EOD.

Irene Morales: TL;DR: MI250X warm pool live in NBO, 40 GPUs total, cap 8/tenant, 6h max, canary now, self-serve next Tue, 1.25x pricing, runbook + CLI linked. Ping me for access or edge cases. :rocket:
